edges.reason: fallback() forwards execution to _fallback().
_fallback invokes the _willFallback hook first.
_fallback delegates execution through _delegate.
_fallback resolves the target via _implementation().
_delegate performs an assembly delegatecall into the externally controlled implementation, which can reenter the proxy.
Proxy._implementation is overridden by BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._implementation.
_implementation sloads IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation before emitting Upgraded.
_setImplementation requires Address.isContract(newImplementation).
_setImplementation sstores the new implementation into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
sendValue executes a low-level call{value: amount}.
recipient is the target of the value-transmitting call.
amount is the value attached to the low-level call.
account is the input to extcodehash in isContract.
initialize calls _setImplementation for _logic.
_logic is stored as the proxy implementation.
initialize delegatecalls _data into _logic.
_logic is the delegatecall target in initialize.
_data is the delegatecall payload in initialize.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize calls InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize.
logic is forwarded as the _logic argument of the inner initializer.
data is forwarded as the _data argument of the inner initializer.
admin argument is written through _setAdmin.
changeAdmin reads the current admin via _admin().
changeAdmin updates the admin via _setAdmin.
_setAdmin sstores the new admin into ADMIN_SLOT.
_admin sloads ADMIN_SLOT.
upgradeTo calls _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall calls _upgradeTo before delegation.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls caller-supplied data into the new implementation, enabling reentry.
newImplementation is the delegatecall target in upgradeToAndCall.
data is the delegatecall payload in upgradeToAndCall.
ifAdmin modifier gates admin() on msg.sender == _admin().
ifAdmin modifier gates implementation() on msg.sender == _admin().
ifAdmin modifier restricts changeAdmin to the admin msg.sender.
ifAdmin modifier restricts upgradeTo to the admin msg.sender.
ifAdmin modifier restricts upgradeToAndCall to the admin msg.sender.
ifAdmin routes non-admin msg.sender calls into _fallback().
_willFallback requires msg.sender != _admin().
_willFallback checks the admin via _admin().
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback calls super._willFallback().
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback delegates to BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback.
